evidence.read: open_with calls open; every first/offset count is zero and every extent/tick is zero; leaky carriers begin empty.

physical_forward opens a fresh moment, continues each distinct source ring once with immutable current, then immediately borrows the source into Word::open_exact_received. Continuing a later ring mutates only that ring counts; it does not age previous rings.

continued clones the moment and selects only the named source ring; the old counts decay before any entering section weight. Each new cell enters once with class-independent closed-form age extent-1-station. Complete supports share the section extent.
open_exact_received first calls source.open_storage through an immutable source borrow; open_storage/encode/normalized feature reads do not call ingest, synchronize_clock, continued, or decay.

Each bound support independently begins from fresh open_with and one continued, then transported_mass and normalized_counts read it immutably. No mutation/aging/rekey occurs between continued and normalization.
Opening radius is calculated before the first Word tick; subsequent Word ticks act on copied physical operands and do not mutate the source moment.

excluded_extension: The denominator/hull claim does not extend to aged, incrementally ingested or repeatedly continued nonempty leaky moments; per-bin post-entry rounding can depend on mixed class split. A future such consumer needs its actual mass/feature admission or refusal.
native_fixture_oracle_scope: All sixteen mixed two-hole completions; total-erasure check only that sixteen-source subset.
